description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git receive-pack behavior with different input limits. It sets up repositories, modifies configurations, and verifies limits and push behaviors.

methods.name: validate_store_type
methods.description: Validates the current repository's store type by examining object counts after push attempts.

methods.name: test_pack_input_limit
methods.description: Runs a series of Git push tests with different unpack limits to verify proper behavior and limits enforcement.
